about: Race-day plan: the course, the drink stations and what you carry. Gels are placed on the clock you have rehearsed, then nudged to land just before a station. The pacing comes from the race session in your plan, so editing that changes the splits. Set `date` to match that session's date or the card will not appear. Delete this file if you do not want a race-day card.
